_comment: The Jetson's steps for omni_console's supervisor (supervisor.py --steps robot). 'robot' is the whole robot: every console mode, Catch included, switches at runtime. VERIFY on the robot: robot.launch.py still starts omni_sim's bridge; the hardware bring-up (real drivers: mcu_link on /dev/ttyACM0, rplidar_ros, the cameras) replaces it, and Jazzy on JetPack 6 runs in Docker (design.md 8), which changes cmd to a 'docker exec'.

steps.label: Robot
steps.hint: The robot's software: every mode from its tab. Started at boot; started again if it crashes (3 times in 5 minutes at most).
